interpretations: For each `rating` among films with `replacement_cost > 20.99`, show the rating, `AVG(length)`, and `AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)`. Each average ignores missing values, and all results remain unrounded.
queries:
SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(length),
  AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
GROUP BY rating
